author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using Strait-Flex Tile-Tape to cover my drywall and shower backer board outside corner. I use thin-set mortar to embed the tape and make it flat. Before I apply the thin-set I dampen the drywall. And I hold the tape in place with a second drywall knife while embedding it onto the backer board. The final step is to lightly remove any excess mortar.
title: Outside Corner Tips Between Drywall and Shower Backer Board - #drywall #showerremodel
